description: This file defines the locale configuration for Chinese (Taiwan) (zh-tw) in the Moment.js library, including localization data such as months, weekdays, date formats, meridiem parsing, and relative time expressions.

methods.name: meridiemHour
methods.description: Adjusts the hour based on the meridiem indicator, handling special cases like noon and midnight.

methods.name: meridiem
methods.description: Returns the meridiem string based on the current hour and minute, categorizing times into segments like '凌晨', '早上', etc.

methods.name: ordinal
methods.description: Generates the ordinal suffix for dates, months, or weeks based on the period.
